name: pytest-dev/pytest
checklist: A changelog fragment exists under changelog/ named <issue>.<type>.rst
The new test fails without the source change
The pull request body is written by the submitting human, not pasted
The submitting human can answer why this fix and not another
notes: AI tools are welcome and maintainers say they use them daily.
Purely agentic pull requests with no human understanding are closed, and repeat cases banned.
Co-authored-by trailers crediting the AI are appreciated but not required.
